bio.topic: Sex hormones, the menstrual cycle and sexually transmitted infections

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which gland releases FSH and LH?
questions.hint: It is a small gland at the base of the brain.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Name the hormone that causes secondary sexual characteristics in males, such as a deeper voice.
questions.hint: It is made in the testes.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which change at puberty is caused by oestrogen?
options: Breast development and widening of the hips
Increase in the size of the testes
questions.answer: Breast development and widening of the hips

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which organ produces oestrogen in females?
questions.hint: This organ also releases the eggs.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: State the main role of FSH in the menstrual cycle.
options: Causes a follicle containing an egg to develop in the ovary
Causes the uterus lining to break down
Prevents the release of any eggs
Maintains the uterus lining during pregnancy
questions.answer: Causes a follicle containing an egg to develop in the ovary

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which hormone triggers ovulation?
questions.hint: Its level surges around the middle of the cycle.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: What is the effect of rising oestrogen on the uterus lining?
options: It thickens and repairs the lining
questions.answer: It thickens and repairs the lining

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which structure secretes progesterone after ovulation?
questions.hint: It forms from what remains of the follicle.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: In a typical 28-day cycle with menstruation starting on day 1, on approximately which day does ovulation take place?
questions.hint: It happens near the middle of the cycle.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: A person has a 30-day cycle. The time from ovulation to the start of the next period is 14 days. On which day of the cycle does ovulation take place?
questions.hint: Subtract the time after ovulation from the cycle length.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: What causes the uterus lining to break down at the end of a cycle when no fertilisation has occurred?

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: What type of pathogen is HIV?
questions.hint: Think about why antibiotics do not cure it.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which type of cell does HIV mainly attack?
questions.hint: These white blood cells are part of the immune response.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Which of these is a way in which HIV can be transmitted?

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Explain why a person infected with HIV may become more likely to develop other infections.
questions.hint: Link the cells attacked by the virus to the immune response.

questions.subject: bio
questions.q: Describe two ways of controlling the spread of HIV and explain how each one works.
questions.hint: Think about barriers and about blood or needles.

questions.q: Qual forma de relevo se caracteriza pelo predomínio da sedimentação sobre a erosão?

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Como se chama a área rebaixada em relação às formas de relevo ao seu redor, formada por erosão?

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: A classificação clássica do relevo brasileiro, baseada no critério erosão × sedimentação, usava quais grandes categorias?

questions.q: Qual categoria a classificação mais recente, de 28 unidades, destacou em relação à clássica?

questions.q: Qual destas é uma planície brasileira de alagamento sazonal?

questions.q: Na comparação entre as classificações, o que ocorreu com a área de planície na Amazônia?
options: Foi reduzida, com áreas reclassificadas como depressão e planalto
Foi ampliada até o Sul do país

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Por que o Brasil não tem cadeias montanhosas muito altas como os Andes?
options: Porque seu território não tem dobramentos modernos
Porque fica sobre o limite ativo entre placas

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual tipo de estrutura geológica antiga, formada por rochas cristalinas, sustenta grande parte dos planaltos brasileiros?

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Que critério ajudou a classificação mais recente a distinguir as unidades de relevo?
options: Estrutura geológica, processos erosivos e forma do relevo

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: A depressão brasileira é, em geral, do tipo relativa porque
options: fica acima do nível do mar, mas abaixo das áreas vizinhas
fica abaixo do nível do mar
fica sob a água do oceano

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Compare a classificação clássica do relevo brasileiro (erosão × sedimentação) com a mais recente, de 28 unidades, indicando uma diferença de critério e uma diferença de resultado.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Analise por que uma classificação de relevo pode mudar ao longo do tempo, mesmo que o relevo quase não mude numa escala humana.

the money spent on advertising only

questions.subject: bus
questions.q: A business's revenue stays the same, but its cost of sales rises. What happens to gross profit?

questions.q: Gross profit rose this year but profit fell. Which is the most likely reason?

It contains a carbon-carbon double bond
It has dissolved completely in water

It is a strongly coloured gas that blocks vision
It is highly acidic and burns skin
It causes water to freeze in the lungs
